/*
#
# HISTORY
# +---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

# | 20250922 | JAY-AR GAVINA  | Initial                                                                                                         |
# +---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
#
*/
SELECT * FROM [EDS].[V_WMG_TRU_UITF]
AS WITH Rolling_Window AS
(
SELECT * FROM
    (
    SELECT 
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Business_Day_Flag ORDER BY FULLDATE DESC) AS RN
    ,* 
    FROM eds.DATE_DIM
        INNER JOIN eds.EDS_CTL
		ON LEFT(FULLDATE,7) = LEFT(DATEADD(MONTH, -1,TRU_DATE),7)
    WHERE Business_Day_Flag = 'Y'
    ) A
),
NONUITF AS
(
	SELECT
		NONUITF.BASE_NO,
		NONUITF.PF_NO,
		NONUITF.BNK_CODE,
		NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE,
		NONUITF.FOLIO_NO
	FROM 
		EDS.TRU_AUMNONUITF NONUITF
		INNER JOIN 
		Rolling_Window RW
		ON NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE = RW.FULLDATE  
	GROUP BY
		NONUITF.BASE_NO,
		NONUITF.PF_NO,
		NONUITF.BNK_CODE,
		NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE,
		NONUITF.FOLIO_NO
)
SELECT 
RW.FullDate AS asofDate,
--NULL AS modifiedDate,
CUST.UNIQUE_ID AS cifNumber,
TA.ACC_NAME AS accountName,
NONUITF.FOLIO_NO AS folioNo,
UITFPF.FUND_CD AS productDescription,
UITFPF.FUND_NM AS referenceNumber,
UITFTRANMST.EFF_DT AS valueDate,
UITFTRANMST.ACQ_AMOUNT AS purchaseAmount,
UITFTRANMST.ACQ_UNIT AS noOfUnits,
UITFTRANMST.UNIT_PRICE AS costPrice,
AUMUITF.NAV AS marketPrice,
AUMUITF.MARKET_VALUE AS marketValue,
AUMUITF.GAIN_LOSS AS unrealizedGainLoss,
PFSUB.RC_DIVISION AS wealthTagging,
PFSUB.REFERRED_BY AS referredBy,
UITFPF.fund_curr_cd AS currency
FROM Rolling_Window AS RW
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_CUST CUST
	ON RW.FullDate BETWEEN CUST.SCD_START_DATE AND CUST.SCD_END_DATE
	AND REF_UNIT = 'PB'
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_BASELINK BASE
	ON  BASE.CIF_NO = CUST.CUST_NO
	AND BASE.BNK_CODE = CUST.BNK_CODE
	AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN BASE.SCD_START_DATE AND BASE.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_PORTFOLIO PORT
	ON  PORT.BASE_NO = BASE.CUST_NO
	AND PORT.BNK_CODE = BASE.BNK_CODE
	--AND PORT.STATUS = 'A'
	AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN PORT.SCD_START_DATE AND PORT.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_PFSUBSCRIPTION PFSUB
	ON  PFSUB.SUBSCRIPTION_ID = PORT.SUBSCRIPTION_ID
	AND PFSUB.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
    AND PFSUB.BNK_CODE = PORT.BNK_CODE
	AND PFSUB.RC_DIVISION = 'PB'
	AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN PFSUB.SCD_START_DATE AND PFSUB.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_ACCOUNT TA
	ON TA.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
	AND TA.PORTFOLIO_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
	AND TA.ACC_NO = PORT.ACC_NO
	AND TA.BNK_CODE = PORT.BNK_CODE
	AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN TA.SCD_START_DATE AND TA.SCD_END_DATE
LEFT JOIN NONUITF
	ON NONUITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
	AND NONUITF.PF_NO = PORT.PORTFOLIO_NO
	AND NONUITF.BNK_CODE = PORT.BNK_CODE
	AND RW.FULLDATE = NONUITF.AS_OF_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_AUMUITF AUMUITF
	ON AUMUITF.BASE_NO = PORT.BASE_NO
	AND AUMUITF.PORTFOLIO_NO = PORT.ACC_NO
	AND AUMUITF.BNK_CODE = PORT.BNK_CODE
	AND RW.FULLDATE = AUMUITF.AS_OF_DATE
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_UITFTRANMST UITFTRANMST
	ON UITFTRANMST.FUND_CD = AUMUITF.FUND_CODE
	AND UITFTRANMST.MASTER_AC_NO = AUMUITF.PORTFOLIO_NO
	AND UITFTRANMST.BNK_CODE = AUMUITF.BNK_CODE
	AND RW.FULLDATE = UITFTRANMST.AS_OF_DATE 
LEFT JOIN EDS.TRU_UITFPF UITFPF
	ON UITFPF.FUND_CD = UITFTRANMST.FUND_CD
	AND UITFPF.BNK_CODE = UITFTRANMST.BNK_CODE
	AND RW.FullDate BETWEEN UITFPF.SCD_START_DATE AND UITFPF.SCD_END_DATE
WHERE
	RW.FULLDATE = AUMUITF.AS_OF_DATE
